title: Location of required parking
previewText: For a residential building on a zoning lot containing an area of no land alteration or designated open space, the provisions of Section 25-622 (Location of parking spaces in lower density growth management areas) that do not permit open off-street parking between the street line and the street wall or prolongation thereof of a building shall not apply.
